problem_statement: OzymaCode/Shoe-Store-Template ships "Kestrel Court", a static one-page sneaker boutique with a navy side navigation, an amber-accented hero, twelve product cards backed by local shoe photography with prices and Add-to-bag buttons, a mobile hamburger menu, and a footer contact form. Shoppers keep asking which US size to order and whether shipping is free, and there is no way to pick a size on the card. Add a per-product size picker with a live "Selected: US N" readout on every card, and add a shared "Fit & shipping guide" bar (true-to-size, free shipping over $95, easy returns, court concierge) that appears CONSISTENTLY in three regions: the hero area, above the product catalog, and in the footer. Clicking a size chip must update that card's readout AND highlight the chosen chip. The guide bar must stay on the Kestrel Court palette (navy chrome, amber accents, off-white/white surfaces) and must NOT introduce horizontal overflow on a 390px phone. Implement it in the existing static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS with no build step, external dependency, or separate page.
required_content: Add a per-product size picker to all twelve cards: size chips (US 7-11) plus a live 'Selected: US N' readout that updates when a chip is clicked, and highlight the chosen chip.

Add a shared 'Fit & shipping guide' bar that appears in THREE regions - the hero area, above the product catalog, and in the footer - with the same fit/shipping info (True to size, Free shipping over $95, Easy returns, Court concierge).

Keep the twelve Kestrel Court product cards and prices: Kestrel Flightpath 88, Talon Court High, Aerie Fastbreak, Merlin Low Suede, Peregrine Trail 2, Harrier Skate Pro, Falconer Mid Canvas, Kestrel Runner Retro, Sparrowhawk Trainer, Kite Pump Court, Osprey Force One, Harrier Dunk Low.
Keep the rebranded footer (Talk To The Court contact form, About links, Kestrel Court contact details incl. hello@kestrelcourt.shop) and the sidebar category navigation.
Style the size chips and the fit/shipping guide bar on the Kestrel Court palette (navy chrome, amber accents on active chips, off-white/white surfaces, softened radius).

Keep the local shoe photography, the twelve-card grid, the mobile hamburger menu, and the desktop/tablet/390px mobile layouts intact and free of horizontal overflow (the fit/shipping guide bar must wrap on narrow phones).
Implement in the existing static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS with no new dependency, external service, hidden-only text, or screenshot-only replacement.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the store shell, the Kestrel Court wordmark/hero, the hero-region fit/shipping guide bar, and the responsive first fold.
desktop_products, tablet_products, and mobile_products capture the twelve-card catalog with the size pickers and the products-region fit/shipping guide bar.
desktop_products_deep and mobile_products_deep verify that the late-catalog cards (Osprey Force One, Harrier Dunk Low) and their size pickers remain visible.
desktop_footer and mobile_footer protect the footer, its contact form, and the footer-region fit/shipping guide bar.
mobile_menu_open verifies the hamburger menu still opens the Kestrel Court navigation.
desktop_size_select verifies that clicking a size chip updates the card readout to 'Selected: US 9' (a real interaction, not a static first paint).
The fit/shipping guide bar must be the same shared component in all three regions and must not overflow a 390px phone.
design_constraints: The 'Fit & shipping guide' bar must appear consistently in the hero, catalog and footer regions - not just one region - so shoppers meet the same fit/shipping info wherever they are.
Style the size chips + guide bar in the Kestrel Court palette (navy/amber/off-white); do not introduce an off-palette treatment or a different template.
Keep the local shoe photography as the primary product visual; do not import external stock imagery.
Preserve the single-page HTML/CSS/vanilla-JS structure, the product grid rhythm, and the mobile hamburger interaction.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must stack cleanly without horizontal overflow; the guide bar must wrap on narrow phones rather than force a fixed-width row.

change_completion: Every card has a size picker whose 'Selected: US N' readout updates on click.
The 'Fit & shipping guide' bar is present in the hero, catalog AND footer regions.
All twelve product names/prices, the footer contact form, and Kestrel Court contact details remain present as real visible text.
design_consistency: The size chips and guide bar use the navy/amber Kestrel Court palette consistently across the three regions.
Local shoe photography remains the product visual and is not distorted or replaced.
The guide bar reads as part of the existing storefront rather than an off-palette bolted-on widget.
regression: Static index.html still serves without a build step or new dependency.
The product grid, footer, contact form, and mobile hamburger behaviour remain available.
No leftover Joe's Clothes / Nike demo names, placeholder text, or blank lower-catalog state is introduced.
interaction: Clicking a size chip updates the card's 'Selected: US N' readout (terminal DOM changes), not just the chip highlight.
responsive: desktop/tablet/mobile initial + product + footer states remain free of horizontal overflow (tol 24).
The fit/shipping guide bar wraps on 390px mobile instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

author_notes: Slot slot_161 hardened to L4 Edit/experience_continuity. On top of the Kestrel Court storefront the reference adds (1) a per-card size picker with a live 'Selected: US N' readout (D4 interaction), (2) a shared 'Fit & shipping guide' bar in the hero, catalog and footer regions (D2 cross-region), styled on the navy/amber palette (D3 visual), and (3) a fluid guide-bar that wraps on mobile (D6 overflow). Baseline places the guide bar only in the catalog region with a fixed 760px non-wrapping row (fails D6+D2+D3, passes D4). The smart-wrong bad places it only in the catalog, masks the overflow with overflow-x:hidden (still overflows), recolors it to an off-palette dark teal, and wires the size chip to toggle .active but writes to a wrong element id so the readout stays stale (fails D6+D2+D3+D4). The only shared INFRA (identical across legs) is surfacing the local shoe photos as DOM tags and linking the new fit-rail.css/fit-rail.js.

metadata.design_goal: add a per-card size picker + a shared cross-region fit/shipping guide bar and repair its mobile overflow, preserving structure and interaction
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static one-page shoe ecommerce template with repeated HTML product cards, CSS background shoe images, sidebar/menu navigation, hero area, footer links, contact form, and vanilla menu toggle.
